basics.name: Xiangyu (Jack) Zhang
basics.label: PhD Student, Computational Chemistry
basics.summary: PhD student in the Liu Group, Department of Chemistry, University of Pittsburgh. Working at the interface of computational chemistry and machine learning: quantum chemistry (Gaussian 16, DFT), classical/ab initio MD, energy decomposition analysis, ML force fields, and ML/MM methods.

work.name: University of Pittsburgh
work.summary: Research in the Liu Group on computational chemistry and machine learning: quantum chemistry calculations (Gaussian 16, DFT), classical and ab initio molecular dynamics, energy decomposition analysis, machine learning force fields, molecular docking, and hybrid ML/MM methods (current focus).
